The '''Chekkoo clan''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It controlled a part east to the [[Betu/Legends|Betu]] continent, allowing a number of minor clans—such as the [[Adebsu clan|Adebsu]] and [[Intamm clan|Intamm]]—to habitat portions of [[Chekkoo Province|their province]] in exchange for their loyalty.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Chekkoo was a powerful clan and was engaged in [[Rodian Clan Wars|century-long wars]], they became cautious and protected the lands around the [[Chekkoo Province]] from strangers. The Chekkoo maintain a small army of [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] who patrolled on foot and air, and hunted any tresspassers; the lucky ones were captured and hauled to the [[Chekkoo Enclave/Legends|Chekkoo Enclave]] for interrogation by the [[Chief Protector]].<ref name="guide" />

The Chekkoo clan was once powerful and dominated its province, claiming final judgment for the lands above the other allied clans. However as it was a major opponent to the ruling [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]], [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]], [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector of Rodia]], isolated the province from trade, impoverishing the Chekkoo.<ref name="guide" />

The Chekkoo traded with [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in order to survive. They also manufactured melee wapons of high quality that could compete modern ones, which they traded.<ref name="guide" /> The local Provincial government made deals with off-world entities such as [[Reena's Interstellar Shipping]], with whom they attempted to replace their aged [[Power fence/Legends|Power fence]] around the enclave.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Provincial Problems|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

The weakened clan could only mind their own business, staying within its own territory and avoiding direct confrontation against the ruling clan.<ref name="guide" /> However during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Rodian in loincloth|Chekkoo clan member]] with his band, attempted to hijack the ''[[Listing Dewback]]'' and its shipment of smuggled weapons, intended for an armed confrontation.<ref name="visit">{{WEGCite|story=A Brief Visit to Rodia|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
